summary.plain: ABRACADABRA-10 cm was a small prototype detector at MIT that looked for a tiny magnetic signal that dark-matter axions would produce inside a toroidal magnet. It finished its axion search around 2021.
summary.technical: Small-scale (10 cm) toroidal lumped-element / broadband-resonant axion haloscope prototype at MIT; completed its dedicated axion dark-matter search program around 2021 after a 1-month first run (2018) and a broadband final run.

technology.value: Lumped-element (broadband/resonant) toroidal magnetometer: a toroidal magnet with a SQUID-based pickup at its center senses the small oscillating magnetic field an axion dark-matter background would induce, rather than using a resonant microwave cavity.
